`ChatV3.wire()` (ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.js, the `/^v-|^[w-]{6,}$/` test): `[w-]` matches only the letter "w" and "-", so the live reply stream only reaches sessions whose id starts with `v-`. Any other id (a uuid, a typed session) gets no streaming. It looks like a typo for `[\w-]`.

Servex/agents/session-smart.md:60 still says "the fast assistant waits about 8 seconds for you and stays quiet if you answered first". With the fast seat off by default this is stale; the paragraph edited at line 16 of the diff fixed the principle but missed this one.

The Question that `Sessions.say()` files for a "?" sentence uses `"q-" + Date.now()` (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:1027). Two "?" sentences in the same millisecond, such as a batch replay, would get the same id; `PromptLines.prompt_id()` already exists for minting ids.

`shots/chat-v3-real-400.png` still shows the link icon on every card, so it was taken before 113cdb730 removed it. No shot shows the new `Chat V1 ▾` version dropdown, and the shots sit loose in `shots/` instead of `shots/<page>/` with a layout.json, so this review could not answer the page systems from them.

`ReciteHighlight` is a new class with pure, testable statics (`word_at`, `words`), but Recite.test.mjs gains no check for it, and no page shows its live instance. A two-line `word_at` check would be cheap.
